login.title: Sign in
login.intro: For the Powercoders team: sign in here.
login.loggedOut: You are signed out, on all devices.
login.passwordChanged: Your new password is active. Sign in with it.
login.invalid_login: Email or password is not correct.
login.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.

admin.title: Administration
admin.totpMissing: The second step is not set up for your account yet.

twofa.title: Second step
twofa.intro: Signed in as {email}. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or one of your backup codes.
twofa.invalid_code: This code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
twofa.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. You will get a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account belongs to this address, a link is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
forgot.invalid_or_expired: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one here.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.intro: New password for {email}. At least {min} characters.
newPassword.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
newPassword.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.

security.title: Security
security.statusOn: The second step is on. At every sign-in the site asks for a code from your authenticator app.
security.statusOff: The second step is not set up yet. With it, signing in needs a code from an app on your phone as well as the password.
security.required: The second step is mandatory for the administration area. Set it up here.
security.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 2FAS. Or type in the key:
security.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
security.backupIntro: Your backup codes. Each is valid once, in case you do not have your phone at hand:
security.backupOnce: Keep them safe now. They are shown only this once.
security.backupLow: Only a few backup codes left. Set up a new device to get new codes.
security.reenrolIntro: With a current code or a backup code you set up a new device. Until you confirm it, the old one stays valid.
security.err_invalid_code: This code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
security.err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
security.err_not_started: The setup has not started. Please begin again.

protocol.title: Log
protocol.intro: The latest actions in the administration area.
